LanguageData.LP_FarRealmFeast.label: Far Realm feast
LanguageData.LP_FarRealmFeast.description: Offer a big pile of twisted meat to the Far Realm in exchange for metals or relics from deep within it. The higher the ritual quality, the better the reward: mithril (15-40), adamantine (8-20), and at very high quality a chance at the rare relic "Eye of Hadar".\n\n+25% quality when led by a Great Old One warlock. The ritual can fail: failure chance = (1 - quality) × 25%, and failure brings a flesh beast swarm or a psychic wail.
